consequence.statement: Composite resources become namespaced by default in v2; existing v1 XRDs continue to work in LegacyCluster mode but v2 XRDs do not support claims.

assertion.statement: Crossplane v2 makes composite resources (XRs) namespaced by default, with a new `scope` field on CompositeResourceDefinition (XRD) that defaults to `Namespaced` in v2 API and XR machinery moved under `spec.crossplane`; v1-style XRDs in `LegacyCluster` mode remain backward compatible without claims support in v2.
